title: Orphan Trains
subtitle: Test your grasp of Orphan Trains — post-Reset clone logistics, DUMBS stem-cell crops, Freemason re-education, WW1 memory purge, and blank-slate control.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Orphan Trains were not charity for urban poverty — they were Re-set logistics. DUMBS grew parentless clones from harvested stem cells. Freemasons stepped out of Arks to teach fake evolution. Trains rolled into standing Tartarian cities after free energy was buried. Mud-floods, giants vaulted by railroad Freemasons, asylums as Loosh batteries for twenty years of maturation — that is the machine. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Orphan Trains deep-dive. The Industrial Revolution was inversion of a superior world's end. Education, finance, and religion hold the blank slate until the next harvest. See the trains for what they are.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Orphan Trains” refers to logistical rail networks used to transport newly generated, parentless children across continents to repopulate fully functioning but emptied cities following a planetary purge.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “Orphan Trains” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Orphan Trains” as: Logistical rail networks used to transport newly generated, parentless children across continents to repopulate fully functioning but emptied cities following a planetary purge.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Orphan Trains”.

questions.question: Why is the philanthropic urban-poverty story about Orphan Trains false?

options.label: A
options.text: They were not philanthropy but an orchestrated system to erase Tartarian knowledge, reboot awareness into ignorance, and restock the parasitic harvest supply.
options.rationale: Philanthropy is cover; real purpose is memory wipe, ignorance reboot, and parasitic supply.

options.label: B
options.text: They were a genuine charity at first, run by churches to help poor city children, and were taken over by the Freemasons once the program had become popular.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Philanthropy is cover; real purpose is memory wipe, ignorance reboot, and parasitic supply.

options.label: C
options.text: They moved children from the countryside into the cities to work in the new factories, with the story of urban poverty invented later to explain the numbers.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Philanthropy is cover; real purpose is memory wipe, ignorance reboot, and parasitic supply.

options.label: D
options.text: They carried children to the Lunatic Asylums, where they were raised alongside the Re-set survivors before being placed with families in the new towns.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. Philanthropy is cover; real purpose is memory wipe, ignorance reboot, and parasitic supply.

questions.hint: Not charity for poverty — erase Tartaria, reboot ignorance, feed parasites.

options.label: D
options.text: Rail networks transporting newly generated, parentless children across continents to repopulate emptied but functioning cities after a purge.
options.rationale: Orphan Trains = rail logistics moving parentless generated children into emptied but intact cities.
